data.name: Niroop
data.gender_notes: Niroop is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'niroopa', meaning 'visible', 'manifest', or 'clear'. In Hindu mythology, Niroopa refers to the form of God Shiva that represents the triumph over illusion. This name is believed to inspire courage and wisdom in the bearer. The name Niroop carries the meaning “Victory over illusion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niroop usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over illusion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Overcoming ignorance and illusion to attain enlightenment.
data.etymology: Niroop belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over illusion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niroop total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Niroop' holds great importance as it represents the triumph over illusion and the ability to see truth and reality in all its forms.
